# On My Way

> On My Way (onmyway.co.il) is a free Hebrew app in Israel that connects drivers who are already on their way with people who need a ride in the same direction (hitchhiking, "טרמפ"). The driver sees how many minutes a rider adds to the trip; the rider knows in advance who is passing, when and where.

- Free to use. A driver may ask for an optional share of fuel costs, within the legal limit; the app does not take any money.
- For adults (18+). Hebrew, right-to-left.
- Runs as an installable web app at https://onmyway.co.il/app/ (Android and iPhone, from the browser).
- Pickups are suggested at safe stops: community hitchhiking spots ("טרמפיאדות"), bus stops and petrol stations.
- Safety: ratings, a personal start code for each ride, trip sharing and an SOS button.
